requirements.quote: Pre-dispatch on about 300 PRs finishes in a few minutes: parallel per-PR reads, cached gh calls, and no repo-wide index walk of nested worktrees (#4126).
A single failed gh read retries and then degrades for that PR only, instead of dropping the whole bundle to full scope.
Progress output per phase, so a long step isn't silent.
A synthetic 300-PR bundle runs pre-dispatch in under 5 minutes.
An injected gh read failure on one PR keeps `SCOPE_MODE=scoped` for the rest.

deliverables.change: Within the bundle-scope-loop block, move the per-PR body into a function that wraps pr view, comments and pr diff reads in gh_retry and writes per-PR result files under $_SD. Run it with bounded parallelism (FORGE_SCOPE_PARALLELISM, default 8), then merge in sorted PR order. A per-PR failure marks the PR degraded (no commits credited, logged, scope stays scoped) and only global failures set full. Print a progress line every 25 PRs and per phase to stderr. Keep the BEGIN/END block markers.

Change the scopefail case to expect scoped with that PR unreviewed. Add a case with 2+ PRs where one read fails permanently and the others stay credited. Add a stubbed 300-PR run asserting it completes well inside 300s, with FORGE_GH_RETRY_SLEEP=0.
Add per-phase progress lines on stderr (index build, each slice batch). Optimise slice() only if a synthetic ~2,900-file diff measures it as material; otherwise progress only.

preserve.what: BEGIN/END markers bundle-scope-loop, bundle-delta-credit and bundle-pr-kind in scripts/review-staging-pre.sh, which scripts/review-pr-staging-scope.test.sh extracts by name.

scope.env and scope.json format and the one-line 'SCOPE_MODE=... reviewed_prs=...' summary, plus <pr>_bundle-pr-files.txt lines of the form '<pr> <file>' (consumed by bin/review-staging.mjs, scripts/review-finalize.sh and the spec).

Fail-closed behaviour for global failures: the git log and diff reads, a missing trusted-comments.sh, and an empty PR list still set SCOPE_MODE=full. The gate subcommand semantics (gate-read-failure never waived) are unchanged.
A degraded PR is never credited as reviewed: widening only, never narrowing scope.

decisions.choice: Degrade a failed PR to unreviewed (scoped) rather than full
decisions.justification: Unreviewed commits are already the safe direction in scripts/review-staging-pre.sh:380-399: they widen review for that PR only. NORTHSTAR non-negotiable 4: a gate that fails open on one read is an input bug.

decisions.choice: Reuse gh_retry for the per-PR reads
decisions.justification: scripts/review-staging-pre.sh:47-64 is already used at :109 and :143.
